title: fix(ci): spec-main shape gate re-points the injected spec's declared dependencies
body:
Fixes #10229
Clause-②: no

## What this changes

`inject` (`scripts/spec-main-shape-gate.mjs`) copied the source-built `@objectstack/spec` into the pnpm virtual store but never read the packed manifest's `dependencies`. The store entry kept the sibling links the lockfile laid down for the published 17.4.0, so a spec built on zod 4.6.1 was read against zod 4.4.3.

**Pass 1: the spec's own siblings.** After the copy, each declared dependency is judged against the sibling the store entry holds:

- a sibling that satisfies the declared range is left exactly as installed;
- one that does not (or is absent) is removed and re-linked to the copy the spec build resolved in the objectstack checkout (the realpath of `packages/spec/node_modules/NAME`). Remove-then-link: a link is replaced, and nothing is written through a hardlink;
- when no copy satisfies the range, `inject` exits 2 naming the dependency. This is decided before the first write.

**Pass 2: objectui's own copies of what pass 1 re-pointed.** This is the seat's option B, range-checked (objectui#10229 comment `5813272343`). For each dependency pass 1 re-pointed to version V (zod today, and only those), every objectui workspace importer declaring the same package is judged. Importers are enumerated from `pnpm-workspace.yaml`; an unsupported glob is exit 2.

- If all its declared ranges admit V, its `node_modules` link is removed and re-linked to the same V copy.
- If a range does not admit V, its copy stays, and the log and run summary print `two copies of X stay: IMPORTER declares R, which does not admit V`. The diagnostics that follow are genuine readings.
- An unreadable importer range is exit 2, before any write.

This models what an install of a release from that commit gives objectui. The new floor falls inside objectui's own range, and `check:lockfile-dedupe` keeps the lockfile deduped, so there is one copy. It is runner state only; no tracked file moves.

Every re-point prints one line to the log and to the run summary. The consumer proof asks every spec consumer and every admitting importer which copy it resolves, and refuses anything but the one copy (exit 2). The workflow passes `--upstream-checkout "$UPSTREAM_CHECKOUT"` (`${{ runner.temp }}/objectstack`, the directory the spec is built in). No other step changed.

Ranges are judged by a deliberately narrow in-file reader, `satisfiesRange`. `semver` does not resolve from the repo root, and importing a hoisted copy would be a phantom dependency. `check-spec-range-floors.mjs` gives the same reason for its own reader. An unreadable spelling is exit 2.

## Reproduction: the gate's own flow, locally, against objectstack `3b5607019f6b` (main)

Sparse blobless clone, `pnpm install --frozen-lockfile --filter @objectstack/spec...`, `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec build`, `npm pack --ignore-scripts`, `inject`, `TURBO_FORCE=true pnpm type-check --continue` (locally with `--concurrency=2`), then the gate's `report`.

| leg | tasks | diagnostics | report |
|:--|:--|:--|:--|
| before: `inject` as on main | 79/81 (failed `app-shell#type-check`, `plugin-designer#type-check`) | **28 × TS2345**, all in the six helper files typed as `ReturnType` of `typeof ObjectSchema.safeParse`; both sides print `.pnpm/zod@4.4.3/.../parse` | exit 1 |
| pass 1 only (commit `0dfe2382`) | 68/81 | 555 in 60 files, 0 in the six helpers; every one an artifact of two zod copies in one program | exit 1 |
| **pass 1 + pass 2 (this head)** | **81/81** | **0** | **exit 0**, "objectui type-checks against `@objectstack/spec` at that commit" |

The six helpers were also compiled directly (`tsc -p tsconfig.test.json` in `app-shell` and `plugin-designer`), because the `&&` in each package's `type-check` hides test projects behind a failed source project. The control leg with the published sibling restored gives 22 + 6 TS2345, all in the six files. With pass 1 they give 0.

**Link targets on the real install** (store entry `@objectstack+spec@17.4.0_ai@7.0.65_zod@4.4.3_`):

- pristine: spec sibling `zod -> ../../zod@4.4.3/node_modules/zod` (4.4.3), and `packages/{app-shell,components,plugin-timeline,test-support,types}/node_modules/zod -> ../../../node_modules/.pnpm/zod@4.4.3/node_modules/zod`. All five declare `^4.4.3`.
- after `inject`: the spec sibling and all five importer links point to `OBJECTSTACK_CHECKOUT/node_modules/.pnpm/zod@4.6.1/node_modules/zod` (4.6.1).
  - `pg-connection-string` is unchanged: 2.14.0 satisfies `^2.14.0`.
  - The `zod@4.4.3` store copy is intact.
  - The log prints 1 substitution line, 5 re-pointed lines and 0 two-copies lines, then `one copy of zod@4.6.1 for 29 spec consumer(s) and 5 objectui importer(s)`.

## This PR's own gate run

`Spec Main Shape Gate` on `bee95b70` (job `107616307783`): **success**. All steps succeeded, and the only annotation is the runner-image notice. objectstack main was still `3b5607019f6b` for that run. The other checks on the head are 37 success and 3 skipped. The previous head, `0dfe2382` (pass 1 only), failed with TS2883 in `packages/types/src/spec-report.ts` naming `.pnpm/zod@4.6.1`, which is the two-copy artifact pass 2 removes.

## Tests and ablation (HEAD `bee95b70`)

- `scripts/__tests__/spec-main-shape-gate.test.ts`, 28/28, run from the repo root. The fixture tests run the real CLI over a synthetic pnpm store, with the script copied into the fixture:
  - pass 1: an unsatisfied sibling is re-pointed and reported; the consumer proof names `zod@4.6.1`; a satisfied sibling is untouched (positive control); exit 2 when no copy satisfies (having written nothing); exit 2 without `--upstream-checkout`;
  - pass 2: an admitting importer (`^4.4.3`) is re-pointed and reported, and the proof prints one copy for consumer and importer; a non-admitting importer (`~4.4.0`) is left in place and reported as two copies, while the admitting one in the same run is still re-pointed; an importer of a package the spec did not re-point is untouched (positive control); an unreadable importer range is exit 2 having written nothing; this repository's `pnpm-workspace.yaml` is readable by the gate;
  - the workflow pin, and `--self-test` (26 checks, including the range and workspace readers in both directions).
- Ablations, all through `ablation-replace`: each anchor went 1 to 0 with the blob changed, and each restore left the blob equal to HEAD with `git diff HEAD` empty. The final tree diff was 0.
  - A (pass 1 removed): 3 red, and the satisfied control stayed green.
  - B (relink removed): 2 red.
  - C (workflow flag deleted): the workflow pin went red.
  - D (sibling never judged satisfied): both positive controls went red.
  - E (pass 2 removed): the admitting, non-admitting and unreadable-range fixtures went red, and the pass-2 positive control stayed green.
  - F (importer range never consulted): the non-admitting fixture went red.
- 12 suites / 333 tests passed: this file, `ci-cd-pipeline-doc`, `dependabot-merge-gate`, `merge-queue-reporting`, `check-merge-queue-head`, `check-test-shard-results`, `check-lockfile-dedupe`, `check-lockfile-integrity`, `check-action-ref-convention`, `check-pre-install-import-graph`, `entry-guard-wiring` and `scripts-type-check`. `pnpm type-check:scripts` exited 0.
- Clean: `check:control-bytes`, `check:action-ref-convention`, `check:shell-escape-residue`, `check:test-path-roots`, `check:vi-mock-override-shape`, `check-entry-guard`, `check-bash32-floor` and `check-pre-install-import-graph`. `check:new-line-citations` reports 0 new. `check-changeset-presence` says no changeset is owed (scripts and workflow only). `check-governed-queue-guard --test` answers NOT GOVERNED.
- eslint, narrowed to the two changed sources with `--no-inline-config`: 0 errors, 0 warnings. `--print-config` shows 118 rules on the test file and 0 on the `.mjs`. No `parserOptions.project` is set, so this is not type-aware linting and the diff cannot move a verdict on an untouched file. The whole-repo `pnpm lint` is CI's.

## Acceptance notes

- `content/docs/guide/ci-cd-pipeline.md` ("How it reaches the spec without moving the pin") does not mention the dependency re-pointing. That file is outside this card's fence. Carrier: none.
- Local timings above are shared-box readings, taken under the container's verify lock.
